more.def: To harm something so that it is broken or works less well.
more.example: The storm damaged the roof of the barn.

easy.example: It is dangerous to play near the road.

more.def: Likely to cause harm or injury.
more.example: Swimming in the river is dangerous when the water is high.

easy.def: To pick what you will do.
easy.example: I can't decide which game to play.

more.def: To make a choice after thinking about it.
more.example: We decided to walk to school instead of taking the bus.

easy.example: Be gentle. The butterfly has delicate wings.

more.def: Easily broken or damaged, so it needs gentle care.
more.example: The delicate glass ornament was wrapped in soft paper.

more.def: Very pleasant to taste or smell.
more.example: A delicious smell of fresh bread came from the kitchen.

easy.example: Baby birds depend on their mother for food.

more.def: To need or trust someone or something for help or support.
more.example: Plants depend on sunlight and water to grow.

easy.def: To tell what something is like.
easy.example: Describe your dog. Is he big or small?

more.def: To use words to tell what someone or something is like.
more.example: She described the storm so well that we could almost hear the thunder.

easy.def: A very dry place with lots of sand and not much rain.

more.def: A very dry area of land that gets little rain and has few plants.
more.example: Only tough plants like cactuses can grow in the desert.

more.def: Not like something or someone else.
more.example: The twins look alike, but they have very different hobbies.

easy.def: To go away so you can't see it.
easy.example: The sun will disappear behind the clouds.

more.def: To go out of sight or stop existing.
more.example: The snow disappeared as soon as the weather warmed up.

easy.def: To make someone sad because something did not happen.
easy.example: I do not want to disappoint my team.

more.def: To make someone unhappy by not doing what they hoped for or expected.
more.example: The canceled trip disappointed the whole class.

easy.def: To find something for the first time.
easy.example: I discovered a tiny shell in the sand.

more.def: To find or learn something that you did not know about before.
more.example: Scientists discovered a new kind of frog in the rainforest.

easy.def: How far it is from one place to another.
easy.example: The distance to school is short.

more.def: The amount of space between two places or things.
more.example: The distance between our town and the ocean is two hundred miles.

easy.def: A long time with no rain.
easy.example: The plants died in the drought.

more.def: A long period with little or no rain, so the land becomes very dry.
more.example: During the drought, the farmers' fields turned brown.
